verdict.rationale: Muse's docs explicitly describe goal/task tracking that runs on a schedule and reacts to events, monitors progress, and notifies the user with results, matching the recurring/one-off automated task story (muse-docs-5, muse-docs-20, muse-docs-24, muse-docs-26). A community stress-test report notes the control plane can time out under heavy load, indicating reliability limits at scale. Missing for 10: independent verification of long-running recurring schedules and quantified success rate under normal (non-stress) conditions.
